request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Whistle Scout".

Creative brief
Name: Whistle Scout
Collection: Ironroad Marauders. Organized highway raiders who turn practical medieval weapons, shields, traps, chains, and stolen supplies into disciplined projectile patterns.
Core concept: A mobile signaler whose whistles preview incoming arrow directions.
Body and silhouette: Slim cloaked lookout with a feathered cap, short bow, and whistle held near the mouth.
Signature features: Long signal feather, brass whistle, and rolled route map.
Palette and materials: Muted green, tan leather, pale brass, and faded red.
Movement personality: Alert, evasive, and always searching for distance.
Attack concept: Faces one direction and whistles, creating visible arrow markers before firing a line of signal bolts from that side.
Directional details: The cap feather bends toward the right.
Avoid: Bard with musical magic, military officer uniform, tiny unreadable bow.
